author: edwong57
body:
Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete:
- **GO:0051204 protein insertion into mitochondrial membrane**, see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32105

The reason for obsoletion is that this is an unnecessary grouping term. It groups insertion into the outer membrane and insertion into the inner membrane, which are distinct pathways with different machinery. Protein import into mitochondria is now represented by **GO:7770058 mitochondrial protein import pathway** and its children (see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31711). GO:0051204 has no replaced_by. Consider:
- GO:7770059 alpha helical protein insertion into mitochondrial outer membrane (MIM/MTCH pathway)
- GO:7770063 beta barrel protein insertion into mitochondrial outer membrane (TOM-SAM pathway)
- GO:0045039 protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane, or its children GO:7770060 (TOM-TIM23-SORT) / GO:7770061 (TOM-TIM22)
- GO:0032979 protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane from matrix (Oxa1/Cox18-type insertion, including of mitochondrially encoded proteins)

Insertion of Bax and other pro-apoptotic proteins into the outer membrane during apoptosis is **not** a mitochondrial import pathway. Annotate it to the apoptotic process instead, e.g. GO:0097345 mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization, or GO:1901030 positive regulation of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization involved in apoptotic signaling pathway.

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1iX0V4Tsh6RGuPihPteJZeXFY3EMpqkYLQ0woDHDeNqY/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups: 
 UniProt  3 
 RGD  2 
MGI 1 
 BHF-UCL 1 - done


Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0051204 protein insertion into mitochondrial membrane
